summary: Computes the AI steering angle toward the current target waypoint. Reads car and target positions, computes the distance to target, projects the direction onto the heading frame, applies a speed-dependent scale, optionally inverts the sign when driverStatus equals 6 (reversing), rate-limits the steering output (max change 0.1 per frame), and clamps the stored output at this+0x442C to the closed range [-1.0, 1.0]. Invoked every frame from AIMainUpdate.

local_names.v2: pointer to current waypoint entry (selected by waypoint index)

operations.description: Derives the address of the current waypoint entry: v2 = this + 4 * waypointIndex(this+0x4468) + 17236.
Computes the signed position delta to the target: v7 = carX(this+0x34E0) - targetX(this+0x4498) and v8 = carY(this+0x34E8) - targetY(this+0x44A0).
Computes sqrt(v8*v8 + v7*v7) and stores it as the distance to target at this+0x44A4.
Predicts the target position components v10 and v11 from the waypoint entry values scaled by the input at this+0x4408, minus the car position.
Normalizes the projection onto the heading frame: v4 = (v11 * sin(this+0x4494) + v10 * cos(this+0x448C)) / sqrt(v11*v11 + v10*v10) — cosine of the angle between heading and target direction.

If the normalized projection v4 is < 1.0, the signed steering magnitude is computed: FloatFunctionPassThrough is invoked, the sign is flipped when the cross product v11*cos - v10*sin > 0, the result is scaled by the speed divisor at this+0x44B4, and the steering sign is inverted again when driverStatus (this+0x4510) equals 6. Otherwise the raw steering magnitude is 0.0.
Rate-limits the steering output: the new value at this+0x442C may move at most 0.1 per frame toward the computed target (clamped to previous +- 0.1).
Clamps the stored steering at this+0x442C: if above 1.0f the raw dword 1065353216 is written and the function returns; if below -1.0f the raw dword -1082130432 is written and the function returns.
Returns after storing the steering output; fall-through path clears this+0x442C to 0.

unresolved: Role of the four read-only float globals flt_59E43C, flt_59E440, flt_59E670, flt_59E84C is not attributable to any source operation; they are likely folded clamp/scale constants but the mapping is not evidenced.
